description: Semantic layer — gold table definitions for the AI chat layer. Every table entry encodes grain, facility scope, mandatory filters, conditional filters, column semantics, and known pitfalls. text_to_sql.py reads this before generating any SQL. Do not query gold tables without reading the relevant entry first.
split_trigger: Split into schema/ directory when: >5 facilities OR >50 metrics. When splitting, split by concern not by table: tables.json, relationships.json, filters.json, business_rules.json, domains.json

notes: default_facility: apply facility = 'KISUMU_CLEAN' on multi-facility tables unless question explicitly spans facilities or names another facility.
exclude_partial_current_month: always add admission_month < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) or equivalent on time-series tables unless question asks for in-progress current month.

prefer_precomputed_metrics: use pre-computed columns (completion_rate_pct, median_los_days, fast_pct, etc.) instead of recomputing from raw columns. Only recompute when aggregating across table grain.

tables.description: Monthly theatre sessions, completion rate, and revenue. KSH only — no facility column.

conditional_filters.reason: Unbooked rows inflate per-theatre session counts. Omit this filter only when explicitly counting all statuses.

tables.fan_out_risk: none — grain is session_month x theatre_name x booking_status, no known duplicates at gold level

completion_rate_pct.note: Pre-computed — do not recompute from total/completed

total_revenue.note: KES. Confirmed FLOAT not NUMERIC (Inv 76) — no TRY_TO_NUMBER()

advisory_notes: Revenue columns are FLOAT, not NUMERIC (Inv 76). No TRY_TO_NUMBER() needed.
KSH only — TENRI has no theatre data. Do not add a facility filter; it will fail.

tables.description: Monthly ward admissions, bed days, LOS, and revenue by ward. Multi-facility. Primary source for ward traffic and ward LOS domains.
tables.grain: admission_month x facility x ward_name x ward_category

mandatory_filters.when: ward-level analysis — always filter ward_name IS NOT NULL when grouping by ward

conditional_filters.reason: Default to KSH unless question explicitly spans facilities
Private Maternity excluded — admission volume too sparse for a stable baseline
Oct 2025 pipeline gap (Inv 32) — exclude when computing rolling averages

tables.fan_out_risk: none at gold level — fan-out fixes applied in silver views

total_admission_revenue.note: Ward accommodation fee only — excludes procedures and ancillary

bed_count_per_ward.warning: Do NOT query INPATIENT_BEDS for bed counts — Snowflake inflates to 161 via flatten duplicates and orphaned ward IDs. Use these hardcoded values only.

advisory_notes: Revenue = ward accommodation fee only (KES 6,000/12,000 flat). Does not include procedure or ancillary revenue.
For median LOS by ward use rpt_ward_los — it has pre-computed median_los_days. This table only supports avg LOS via SUM(total_bed_days)/SUM(discharged_admissions).

tables.description: Monthly median LOS per ward by facility. Use for LOS domain — median is pre-computed and preferred over avg.

median_los_days.note: Pre-computed median — use this, not avg

advisory_notes: Always use median_los_days — average LOS is unreliable due to extreme outliers (max 139d in Maternity, Inv 22).
Silver exception previously used — now resolved. Gold table is authoritative for median LOS.

tables.description: 30-day readmission rates by discharge type, ward, and payment mode. Multi-facility. Also the source for Patient Request discharge domain via conditional filter.
tables.grain: admission_month x facility x ward_category x discharge_type x payment_mode

mandatory_filters.when: any analysis grouped by discharge_type — NULL rows represent unclassified discharges

conditional_filters.reason: Isolates patient-initiated discharges — the Patient Request discharge domain
Revenue at risk applies to insured patients only

discharge_type.note: NULL = unclassified. 'Patient Request' is the patient-initiated discharge type.

advisory_notes: readmission_30day_rate_pct is pre-computed — use it directly.

tables.description: Monthly evaluation visits and admission conversion rate per doctor. KSH only.

conditional_filters.reason: Conversion rate data reliable from Sep 2024 onwards

username.note: Doctor identifier — do not use as a current-state name in responses

advisory_notes: KSH only — do not add a facility filter.
username reflects current doctor — do not cite a specific username in a chat response. Report concentration % and rank only.

tables.description: Monthly lab visit volume and abnormal rate. KSH only. Data from Jul 2025.

conditional_filters.reason: CL/CH flag format introduced mid-2025. Earlier data is incomplete.

distinct_visits.note: Unique patient visits with lab activity

advisory_notes: Data available from Jul 2025 only — CL/CH flag format introduced mid-2025. Earlier months undercount.

tables.description: Monthly dialysis throughput, revenue, and machine utilisation. KSH only.

conditional_filters.reason: Partial months undercount sessions and revenue — exclude for trend analysis

tables.fan_out_risk: none at gold level. Silver stg_dialysis_billing deduped both FINANCE_INVOICE_ITEMS and FINANCE_INVOICES — both had exact-duplicate rows from ingestion (Inv 80). Gold is clean.

utilisation_pct_theoretical.note: Pre-computed: sessions / (machines x sessions_per_day x days)

advisory_notes: Descriptive metrics only — no threshold alerts for this table. Report utilisation_pct_theoretical and sessions_billed trend.
Silver dedup applied (Inv 80) — gold is clean. Do not add dedup logic at query time.

tables.description: Monthly rate of critical creatinine patients who were not admitted. KSH only. Data from Jul 2025.

conditional_filters.reason: CL/CH flag format introduced mid-2025. Earlier data is incomplete.

advisory_notes: CD12 = critical creatinine non-admission alert. High non_admission_rate_pct = critical renal patients discharged without dialysis referral.
Data from Jul 2025 only — same chain as rpt_lab_monthly.

tables.description: Monthly imaging sessions and revenue by modality. Multi-facility.

conditional_filters.reason: Imaging CT domain tracks CT sessions only

advisory_notes: Other modalities (MRI, ECHO, Ultrasound, X-Ray) exist in this table but are outside the 24-metric registry scope.

tables.description: Monthly admission TAT — fast-track rate and P50/P75 wait times. KSH only.

conditional_filters.reason: Rolling 6-month window gives stable trend without historical noise

query_restrictions.restriction: Do not use PERCENTILE_CONT or MEDIAN() against this table at query time.
query_restrictions.reason: p50_tat_min and p75_tat_min are pre-computed in gold. Re-computing at query time requires row-level data that is not in this aggregated table.

advisory_notes: KSH only — do not add a facility filter.
